title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-02-28
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/48; Edited & Mastered in Audacity by Joe Noel: Wave > Flac 16/48
source: flac16/48kHz; SBD > 2-track Master Reels > Dat; Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a magical early‑1969 show featuring Pigpen’s swagger, a drenched “Lucy in the Sky” opener and a soaring second‑set jam into “Death Don't Have No Mercy”.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this recording, calling it a ‘seriously great listen’ that transports you back to 1969. The first set is highlighted for Pigpen’s swagger and a vivid rendition of “Lucy in the Sky”, while the second set delivers deep Dead jamming culminating in an emotional “Death Don't Have No Mercy”. The two‑track soundboard source sounds clean enough that no technical complaints were raised.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the performance and listening experience; recording quality is inferred as high from the SBD source, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Two‑track soundboard mix praised for clarity; no specific flaws mentioned by reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as ‘drenched’ with strong Pigpen presence; second set is a deep, exploratory jam that builds to an emotional climax.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's swagger and vocal/organ work are highlighted as a major strength of the performance.
